title: The Tabby Cat

doing.t: is asleep with one paw over its eyes
is dozing with its tail wrapped round its feet
is folded into a neat bundle with its paws tucked away
is pretending not to watch the birds
is kneading a crocheted blanket with slow, blissful paws

close: Just the tabby, asleep in a stripy comma, filling the page.
Only the cat's sleeping face, with the M on its forehead right in the middle.

roles.dark: for the stripes and the closed eyes
roles.light: for the chin, the chest and the whiskers
roles.accent: for the pink nose and the insides of the ears

firstMark: Start with the M on the forehead in short, sharp strokes of {dark}.
Start with the stripes: a few curved bands of {dark} that wrap round the body, drawn lightly.

title: The Ginger Kitten

doing.t: is batting at a loose end of wool
is chasing the tip of its own tail
is asleep in a heap of legs and whiskers
is peeping out of a paper bag
is stalking a leaf as it skitters past

close: Just the kitten, mid-pounce, with its front paws spread wide.
Only the kitten's face, ears first, as big as the page allows.

roles.dark: for the eyes and the deepest stripes
roles.light: for the cream chin and paws
roles.accent: for the pink nose and paw pads

firstMark: Start with the eyes: two big circles of {dark}, each with a dot of bare paper left in it.
Start with the ringed tail in short, curved bands of {main}.

title: The Black Cat

doing.t: is sitting like a china ornament with its tail over its toes
is staring at something nobody else can see
is washing a back leg hoisted high in the air
is picking its way along with its tail up like a question mark
is weaving in and out of a pair of muddy wellies

close: Just the black cat, sitting tall, with a thin rim of light on its back.
Only the cat's face: two green eyes floating in soft black.

roles.dark: for the deepest shadow under the chin and belly
roles.light: for the blue sheen on the back and the whiskers

firstMark: Start with the shine: mark the strip where light runs along the back, then lay {main} all around it.
Start with the eyes, then build {main} up around them so the green glows.

title: The Springer Spaniel
phrases: ears that dip in the water bowl
a tail that wags the whole dog

doing.t: is having a tremendous shake from ears to tail
is carrying a stick far too big for it
is gazing up with hopeful brown eyes
is flat out on its side after a long walk
is following its nose with its tail going like a metronome

close: Just the spaniel's head, curly ears and all, with its tongue out.
Only the spaniel, mid-shake, ears flying.

roles.main: for the liver-brown ears and patches
roles.dark: for the nose, the eyes and the curls on the ears
roles.light: for the white blaze and the freckled legs
roles.accent: for the pink of the tongue

firstMark: Start with the nose: a damp, shiny shape of {dark}, with a speck of paper left for the gleam.
Start with the ears in loose, looping curls of {main}.

title: The Dachshund

doing.t: is hurrying off with its ears bouncing
is sitting up to beg with its front paws dangling
is lying stretched out like a sausage roll
is burrowing under a blanket until only its tail shows
is wearing a knitted jumper and looking very pleased with itself

close: Just the dachshund, side on, stretching all the way across the page.
Only the dachshund's head, with its ears hanging like two suede flaps.

roles.dark: for the eyes, the nose and the shadow under the long belly
roles.light: for the shine along the back
roles.accent: for the red collar and the insides of the ears

firstMark: Start with the long line of the back in one light, unbroken stroke of {main}.
Start with the nose: a glossy bead of {dark} at the very end of that long snout.

title: The Old Sheepdog
phrases: one ear up, one ear down

doing.t: is lying with its chin on its paws and one eye open
is dreaming of sheep with its paws twitching
is thumping its tail at the sound of its name
is sitting to attention with its head held high
is crouched low, giving a stray hen the eye

close: Just the old dog's head, greying at the muzzle, with kind, patient eyes.
Only the sheepdog, lying down with its front paws crossed.

roles.dark: for the deepest fur and the nose
roles.light: for the white ruff, the blaze and the paws
roles.accent: for the amber of the eyes

firstMark: Start with the eyes: two warm brown circles, each ringed with {dark}.
Start with the white ruff by drawing round it in {main}, so the paper does the work.

title: The Speckled Hen

doing.t: is scratching about and muttering to herself
is announcing her new egg to anyone who will listen
is turning one eye down to inspect a beetle
is dust-bathing with her wings spread flat
is sitting tight on a clutch of eggs

close: Just the hen, side on, every speckle accounted for.
Only the hen's head, bright red comb and all, close enough to see her eye.

roles.dark: for the black bar near the tip of each feather
roles.accent: for the red comb and wattles

firstMark: Start with the eye: a small amber circle with a pupil of {dark}.
Start with the speckles: leave small dots of bare paper and work {main} in around each one.

title: The Box of Chicks

doing.t: is cheeping at full volume
is a heap of yellow fluff with one chick asleep on top
has one brave chick trying to climb out
has one chick nodding off on its feet

close: Just one chick, round as a bread roll, with its eyes closed.
Only the box, seen from above, with every chick crowded into one corner.

roles.dark: for the beady eyes and the shadows in the box
roles.light: for the fluffiest tops of the heads
roles.accent: for the orange beaks and feet

firstMark: Start with the eyes: one sharp dot of {dark} for each chick, before any fluff.
Start with the inside corners of the box in {dark}, so the chicks have something to glow against.

title: The Lamb
phrases: springs up for no reason at all

doing.t: is leaping straight up as if the ground were hot
is guzzling from a bottle with its tail whirring
is lying down with its legs folded under it
is head-butting its twin
is bleating for its mum with its mouth wide open

close: Just the lamb, mid-leap, with its legs pointing four different ways.
Only the lamb's face, with its ears sticking out sideways like a pair of leaves.

roles.dark: for the eyes, the nostrils and the shadows between the curls
roles.light: for the tops of the curls
roles.accent: for the pink inside the ears

firstMark: Start with the fleece in small, loose circles of {main}, like a row of curls.
Start with the eyes: two dark sideways ovals of {dark}, set wide apart on the face.

title: The Spotted Pig
phrases: a snout like a big pink button

doing.t: is rootling about with its snout
is trotting along on neat, pointed trotters
is munching an apple with a look of pure bliss
is snoozing with its ears flopped over its eyes
is wallowing in mud up to its chin

close: Just the pig's face, snout first, with its ears tipped forward.
Only the pig, side on, from the end of its snout to the curl of its tail.

roles.dark: for the black spots and the shadow under the belly
roles.light: for the bristly highlights on the back
roles.accent: for the wet nose and the curly tail

firstMark: Start with the snout: a flat oval with two nostrils of {dark}.
Start with the spots as soft-edged patches of {dark}, then bring the pink up to meet them.

title: The Highland Cow
phrases: too much hair to see out

doing.t: is peering out through its fringe
is chewing slowly with a faraway look
is lying down like a russet haystack
is licking its own nose with a long, curling tongue
is standing guard over a woolly calf

close: Just the cow's head, from the tips of its horns to its wet black nose.
Only the cow, side on, like a great russet hearthrug on legs.

roles.dark: for the deep shadows in the coat and under the fringe
roles.light: for the pale horns and the sunlit tips of the hair

firstMark: Start with the fringe in long, downward flicks of {main}, falling over where the eyes would be.
Start with the nose: a broad, damp shape of {dark} peeping out below all that hair.

title: The Goat Kid
phrases: a bleat like a creaky gate

doing.t: is balancing on top of an upturned bucket
is bouncing sideways on stiff legs
is nibbling the frayed end of a rope
is bleating with its tongue sticking out
is standing on its back legs to reach a leaf

close: Just the kid, all four hooves bunched together on top of something it shouldn't be on.
Only the kid's face, looking straight at you with those odd sideways pupils.

roles.dark: for the eyes, the hooves and the stripe down the back
roles.light: for the white face markings and legs
roles.accent: for the pink inside the long ears

firstMark: Start with the eye: a pale amber oval with a sideways bar of {dark} across it.
Start with the legs: four thin, knobbly lines of {main}, then hang the body from them.

title: The Donkey
phrases: a dark cross along its back
a hee-haw like a rusty pump

doing.t: is dozing with one back hoof tipped up
is braying with its lips curled back
is leaning its head over a friend's neck
is rolling on its back with its legs in the air
is nibbling a thistle, carefully avoiding the prickles

close: Just the donkey's head, ears and all, gazing out of the page.
Only the donkey's pale, velvety muzzle and whiskers, close up.

roles.dark: for the cross on the back, the tips of the ears and the hooves
roles.light: for the pale muzzle and the rings round the eyes
roles.accent: for the warm brown of the eyes

firstMark: Start with the long ears in two upright strokes of {main}, tipped with {dark}.
Start with the dark cross: one line down the spine and one across the shoulders in {dark}.

title: The Lop-Eared Rabbit
phrases: ears like a pair of oven gloves

doing.t: is flicking its heels in a sudden, joyful leap
is flopped out on its side with its eyes half shut
is working its way through a sprig of parsley
is nudging a cardboard tube along with its nose
is up on its haunches with its nose going nineteen to the dozen

close: Just the rabbit, side on, with its ears hanging down past its chin.
Only the rabbit's face, nose mid-twitch, between two long, drooping ears.

roles.dark: for the eye and the shadows under the ears
roles.light: for the pale belly and the powder-puff tail
roles.accent: for the pink of the nose and the insides of the ears

firstMark: Start with the ears: two long, drooping shapes of {main} hanging down past the chin.
Start with the whisker pads: two soft bumps either side of the nose, shaded underneath with {dark}.

title: The Guinea Pig
phrases: whistles at the rustle of a bag

doing.t: is munching a stalk of hay that keeps getting shorter
is chomping on a slice of cucumber
is touching noses with a friend
is doing sudden popcorn jumps for joy

close: Just the guinea pig, side on, a round loaf with a nose.
Only the guinea pig's face, with a strand of hay hanging out of its mouth.

roles.dark: for the black patches and the eyes
roles.light: for the white blaze and the fluffiest fur
roles.accent: for the pink feet and ears

firstMark: Start with the outline as one lumpy, potato-shaped line of {main}.
Start with the eye: a shiny black dot of {dark}, set high on the side of the head.

title: The Goldfish
phrases: a tail like a silk fan

doing.t: is opening and closing its mouth as if about to speak
is nosing up at a floating flake of food
is hovering with its fins barely stirring
is swimming through the arch of a toy castle
is gazing out with its face pressed to the glass

close: Just the goldfish, side on, with its tail fanned out behind it.
Only the bowl and its fish, with the window reflected in the curve of the glass.

roles.dark: for the eye and the deepest orange on the back
roles.light: for the shine on the glass and the bubbles
roles.accent: for the sprig of green water weed

firstMark: Start with the fish itself in {main}, then draw the bowl around it so the fish is never too small.
Start with the eye: a single dot of {dark} inside a ring of gold.
